name: Nature's Archon
description:
You deal more Damage with Plant Skills. 
More Skill Effect Duration with Plant Skills. 
Plant Skills are Overgrown. 
Additional Limit to Plant Skills.
keywordDefinition:
Nature's Archon is a type of Archon Buff. It grants:
• 25% more Damage with Plant Skills
• Plants have a 100% chance to immediately Overgrow
• 200% more Skill Effect Duration of Plant Skills
• Plant Skills have +2 to Limit
